title: Soil unknown, irrigated, Banat plain, mid-September
rationale: With soilClass unknown no soil-based inclusion or exclusion is possible: this case exists to check that the model does not fabricate soil confidence. The only assertion left is the calendar one — rapita_toamna's Banat and west/north windows (09-01 → 09-10) and the national hybrid window (08-20 → 08-31) all closed before the case date. lowData is true, so confidence must not be high.
